title: Ɛnne a Ɛfrɛɛ Trenee
intro: Wɔ tete Midian asaase no so, baabi a aguadi nyaa nkɔsoɔ na akwantufoɔ tu kwan fa sare akɛseɛ so no, Allah nkɔmhyɛfoɔ bi sɔree wɔ nkurofoɔ a wɔayera afiri atɛntenenee kwan no so. Wɔsomaa saa Allah akoa yi sɛ ɔde ɔsoro asɛmpatrɛ adwuma bi a ɛbɛsɔ ɔmanfoɔ nyinaa gyidie ahwɛ. Ɛdenam boasetɔ ne boasetɔ sɔhwɛ ahorow so no, ɔkra yi gyinaa pintinn de kɔkɔbɔ a ɛbɛka wɔ abakɔsɛm mu no mae. So wubetumi ahu ɔbɔfo a ogyina pintinn yi ahintasɛm mu?
clues: Allah na ɔpaw me sɛ menkyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ bi a wɔn werɛ afiri nnyinasosɛm a ɛfa atɛntenenee ne nokwaredi ho wɔ wɔn nkitahodie mu.
Mede nkra bi maeɛ a ɛfrɛɛ me mpɔtam hɔfoɔ sɛ wɔnsom obiara gye Allah na wɔmfa nokorɛ nkasa wɔ nsɛm nyinaa mu.
Mebɔɔ kɔkɔ pɔtee wɔ adifudepɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛfa akwan a mmara mma ho kwan so di ahonyade no ho na misii hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde nneɛma a wɔde kari ade ne nea wɔde susuw nneɛma a ɛfata di dwuma no so dua.
Me nkurɔfo de fɛwdi buaa me kɔkɔbɔ ahorow no, na wohunahunaa me sɛ sɛ metoa me nkrasɛm no so a, wɔbɛpam me afi wɔn asase so.
Mekɔɔ so sii me bo wɔ m’asɛmpatrɛ adwuma no mu ɛmfa ho sɛ na wɔtan no, na mepaee mu kae sɛ m’akatua wɔ Allah nko ara nkyɛn.
Asotwe a ɛyɛ hu kyeree me nkurɔfo bere a m’Awurade mmɔborohunu gyee me nkwa no, bere a m’asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no baa mu no.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Nkurofoo a wopoo nokore na wohunahuna asotwe wo se wode Allah nkra no mae no anim
Nsuyiri Kɛse a ɛsɛee ɔman bi a wonnye nni no ho adanse
Adiyisɛm a wogye bere a woretu kwan afa bonhwa mu
Gyidi ho sɔhwɛ bere a sodifo bi a ɔhyɛ nkurɔfo so bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛma ɔfrɛ a wɔde kɔ onyame biakoyɛ mu no ayɛ komm no
Ɔman bi商a wɔrebisa osuo wɔ ɔpɛ a emu yɛ den mu wɔ mfeɛ pii asoɔden akyi
trial.answer: Nkurofoo a wopoo nokore na wohunahuna asotwe wo se wode Allah nkra no mae no anim

location.label: Ade Titiriw
options: Midian asase a na me nkurɔfoɔ yɛ wɔn aguadi ne wɔn aguadi wɔ hɔ
Hyɛn kɛse bi a egyee agyidifo no fii nsuyiri a ɛyɛ hu mu no atifi
Ɔbodan bi a ɛwɔ bepɔw bi a abotan so a mmerante baason hwehwɛɛ guankɔbea fii ɔtaa mu
Yerusalem kurow kronkron a wɔde me kɔɔ hɔ anadwo biara
Ahemfie bi a ɛwɔ Seba a ahenni kɛse bi siesiee ne ho sɛ wobehu ɔsoro sɛnkyerɛnne bi
location.answer: Midian asase a na me nkurɔfoɔ yɛ wɔn aguadi ne wɔn aguadi wɔ hɔ

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Asotwe a ɛyɛ hu kyeree me nkurofoɔ berɛ a na wɔgye me nkwa no, ɛfiri sɛ na madi m’asɛdeɛ a mede ma Allah
Wɔdanee atiafoɔ no yɛɛ akraman berɛ a wɔbuu Allah ahyeɛ kronkron no
M’atamfo gyee gyidi toom bere a wohuu nsakrae anwonwakwan so akyi
Wɔde osu bebree ne yiyedi hyiraa asase no so bere a nkurɔfo no nuu wɔn ho akyi
M’ankasa nkurɔfo kunkum me sɛ mepowee sɛ megyae m’asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no
outcome.answer: Asotwe a ɛyɛ hu kyeree me nkurofoɔ berɛ a na wɔgye me nkwa no, ɛfiri sɛ na madi m’asɛdeɛ a mede ma Allah

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verse: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh? (26:177)
